user.title: Connect to Famio
user.description: Address of the Famio server (e.g. 192.168.1.50 – HTTPS on port 8766 is used – or https://famio.example.org) and a Famio account. Home Assistant sees what this member sees; best create a separate account "Home Assistant". Two-factor login is supported: the code is asked for once.

certificate.title: Check the server's certificate
certificate.description:
{url} uses its own certificate. Compare the fingerprint with the server log (e.g. `journalctl -u famio` or `docker logs famio`) or the Famio app:

`{fingerprint}`

Only confirm if it matches.

two_factor.title: Two-factor login
two_factor.description: {username} signs in with two-factor authentication. Enter the 6-digit code from the authenticator app (or a recovery code). Home Assistant stays signed in afterwards – a code is only needed again if the session is signed out in Famio.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in to Famio again
reauth_confirm.description: The session of {username} was ended (e.g. signed out in the app). Please enter the password again.

error.code_expired: The sign-in expired. Please enter the password again.
error.two_factor_setup: Two-factor login is mandatory for this member but not set up yet. Sign in once with this member in a Famio app and set it up there, then try again.
error.invalid_cert: The server's certificate does not match the confirmed fingerprint.

abort.already_configured: This Famio account is already connected.

dashboard.name: Create dashboard
dashboard.description: Creates a family dashboard (calendar, per person events, tasks and points, shopping lists, map) as YAML. Paste it under Settings → Dashboards → Add dashboard → New dashboard → ⋮ → Raw configuration editor.

config_entry_id.name: Famio connection
config_entry_id.description: Only needed with several Famio connections.
